submitted.rationale: With 2.06 eV illumination, BiVO4 alone (~2.4 eV gap) cannot absorb, so photoactivity must come from Cu-containing phases such as copper vanadates or CuBi2O4. Of the three compositions measured, index 2 (Bi0.22 Cu0.25 V0.53) and index 8 (Bi0.13 Cu0.35 V0.52) both gave 2e-8 A. The Bi-rich index 205 gave 0. Index 2 was measured first and is submitted; index 8 gives the same reading.

rejected.reason: Bi-rich, near-CuBi2O4 composition gave zero photocurrent
Photocurrent equal to index 2 (2e-8 A), so it is no better
